communityPosts.title: Water Supply Disruption – Aug 5-6
communityPosts.body: PMC has informed that water supply to Karve Nagar area will be disrupted on Aug 5-6 (Tuesday-Wednesday) due to pipeline repair work near Vanaz corner. Please store adequate water. Tanker has been arranged for emergency supply – contact security desk.

communityPosts.title: Weekend Tree Plantation Drive – Sambhaji Park
communityPosts.body: Join us this Sunday (Aug 10) for a community tree plantation drive at Sambhaji Park. We'll plant 50 saplings of native species (Neem, Peepal, Banyan). Refreshments provided. Bring your own gardening gloves!

communityPosts.title: Should we install EV charging stations in the parking?
communityPosts.body: We've received quotes from 2 vendors. Installation cost will be ₹2,50,000 (one-time) from maintenance fund. Usage will be pay-per-charge. Please vote.

communityPosts.title: Stray dogs aggressive near Gate 2 – Safety concern
communityPosts.body: For the past week, a pack of 4-5 stray dogs near Gate 2 have been barking aggressively at residents, especially children returning from school. One child was chased yesterday. Can we contact PMC Animal Control?

communityPosts.title: FOUND: Gold earring near Dahanukar Colony bus stop
communityPosts.body: Found a gold earring (small jhumka style) near the Dahanukar Colony bus stop this morning around 7:30 AM. DM me with a description to claim. Will hold for 7 days.

communityPosts.title: iPhone 15 Pro Max for sale – ₹45,000 only!!
communityPosts.body: Brand new sealed iPhone 15 Pro Max. No bill. Cash only. Meet at Hadapsar market yard. DM fast.
communityPosts.moderationAction: Post hidden pending review. User already under FRAUD-2026-0042 investigation.

supportTickets.subject: Order delivered to wrong address
supportTickets.description: My order #ord_20260801_005 from Patil Kirana was delivered to Flat 301 instead of Flat 302. The neighbor kept it but some items are missing (1L milk, curd).

messages.body: My order was delivered to the wrong flat. Missing items: Chitale milk 1L and Amul curd.
Ticket assigned to support agent. Expected response within 4 hours (Gold SLA).

Hi Priya, apologies for the inconvenience. We've confirmed with the delivery runner (Vikram). Refund of ₹88 has been credited to your cashback wallet. We'll retrain the runner on address verification.
Thank you! Received the refund. Appreciate the quick resolution.

supportTickets.subject: Weekly payout failed – UPI timeout
supportTickets.description: My weekly payout of ₹5,000 failed on Aug 2. Error says UPI timeout. I need this money urgently for rent. Please process manually.

messages.body: Payout failed. Error: UPI timeout. Please retry.
Hi Vikram, we see the failure (ref: pay_runner_04_failed). Retrying via NEFT now. Should reflect in 2-4 hours.

supportTickets.subject: How to enable subscription box feature?
supportTickets.description: I want to offer weekly grocery subscription boxes but can't find the option in my shop dashboard. Is it available on Gold plan?

messages.body: Where is the subscription box feature in the dashboard?

Hi Rajesh! Yes, subscription boxes are available on Gold plan. Go to Shop Dashboard > Products > Subscription Boxes > Create New. You'll need to set up at least 3 items and a delivery schedule. I've attached a guide. Let me know if you need help.
